assistant|slow_cooker_recipe_recommendat: Recommended slow cooker recipes: chili con carne, pulled pork, beef stew, Korean BBQ beef, Indian butter chicken, Mexican chicken tacos, lentil curry, roasted vegetable stew, black bean chili, mac and cheese, chicken and dumplings, pot roast, Greek chicken, Jamaican jerk chicken, and breakfast casserole
assistant|yogurt_recipe: Slow cooker yogurt recipe: heat 1/2 gallon milk on low 2-3 hours to 180-185°F, cool to 110-120°F, add 1/4 cup plain yogurt with live cultures, incubate wrapped 8-12 hours, then chill and store
assistant|yogurt_temperature_advice: Advised that a thermometer is highly recommended for yogurt making because 180-185°F kills unwanted bacteria and denatures proteins, but yogurt can be made without one by watching for simmering bubbles
assistant|vegetarian_recipe_recommendati: Recommended vegetarian slow cooker recipes: lentil curry, roasted vegetable stew, black bean chili, eggplant parmesan, and butternut squash risotto
assistant|vegan_recipe_recommendations: Recommended vegan slow cooker recipes: vegan chili, quinoa and black bean bowl, lentil and mushroom stew, vegan mac and cheese, and chickpea and spinach curry
assistant|vegan_yogurt_base_options: Listed vegan yogurt bases: soy, coconut, almond, cashew, oat, rice, hemp, and flax, with brands like Silk, So Delicious, Coconut Bliss, Coyo, Almond Breeze, Oatly, Rice Dream, Good Karma, and Elmhurst 1925
assistant|yogurt_flavoring_options: Suggested yogurt flavorings: vanilla, cinnamon, fruit, nutmeg, ginger, lemon, and cocoa
assistant|yogurt_sweetener_options: Suggested yogurt sweeteners: honey, maple syrup, coconut sugar, date syrup, monk fruit sweetener, and stevia
assistant|cashew_soaking_method: Cashew yogurt base method: rinse 1 cup cashews, soak at least 4 hours or overnight, drain and rinse, blend with 1/2 cup fresh water on high about 2 minutes until smooth, then strain
assistant|cashew_yogurt_consistency_tips: Advised that a 1:1 cashew-to-water ratio gives a baseline, less water makes thicker yogurt, longer blending makes it thinner, and chilling at least 2 hours helps it set
assistant|straining_tool_comparison: Compared straining tools: cheesecloth gives the best filtration but is messy, nut milk bags are designed for plant milks but pricey, and a fine-mesh sieve is accessible but may leave a grainy texture
assistant|vegan_yogurt_starter_advice: Recommended using a vegan yogurt starter or probiotic powder specifically designed for plant-based yogurts when culturing cashew yogurt
